_doc: Warrior line cards (job 100; spec #151 ticket #163). Card format and tier rules: see ../upgrades.json _doc. Every card requires job 100 and, through its skill, a held weapon the skill can use (UpgradePool: Power Strike and Slash Blast need a Warrior melee family). Rarity is the shared Potential table (upgrades.json rarity and magnitudes): learn cards start at the tier's rank, rank cards gain its ranks, modifier cards stack its steps. Offer weights, step sizes and maxima below are tier C (ours, untuned until the balance pass); canonical skill caps are tier A. Extra targets come only from the target cards (the canonical Power Strike hits 1 monster, Slash Blast up to its mobCount 6).
